extras: Uses a workaround for Obsidian's lazy loading to ensure full Markdown rendering.
intentEvidence: giving you a scaled-down visual overview of the entire note.
motivation: Inspired by modern code editors, it helps users navigate long markdown files faster and with more spatial awareness.
problem: Navigating long Markdown files can be difficult without a quick visual reference for the note's structure.
summary: Note Minimap adds a scaled-down visual overview of the entire note within the editor pane, allowing users to navigate long Markdown files faster.
